page_title: STR 1-2 MAR | Strasbourg v Marseille 26/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+1' 1 - 2 Goal! Michael Murillo (Marseille) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top right corner. It's 1:2.
90+1' Emerson (Marseille) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the crossbar!
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
88' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom right corner, but Mike Penders is equal to it and makes an easy save.
85' Andrea Maldera prepares a substitution. Facundo Medina is replaced by Robinio Vaz (Marseille).
85' The referee allows time for a substitution. Matt O'Riley will be replaced by Benjamin Pavard (Marseille).
85' Here comes a substitution. Samir El Mourabet (Strasbourg) is brought on as a substitute for Valentin Barco.
85' Today's match ends for Guela Doue who will be replaced by Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg).
80' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the left post with a fine header. What a chance!
78' 1 - 1 Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) gets to the rebound and sends it goalwards, surprising the goalkeeper, who watches the ball go into the back of the net.
75' A cross into the box from Facundo Medina (Marseille) is cleared.
71' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

68' Michael Murillo (Marseille) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jeremie Pignard no option but to blow his whistle. Strasbourg are awarded the free kick.
66' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
66' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing.
63' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
62' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Strasbourg can continue in their attacking effort.
62' Substitution. Emanuel Emegha makes way for Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg).
60' Matt O'Riley (Marseille) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
58' Substitution. Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) has come on for Amine Gouiri.
58' Andrea Maldera decides to make a substitution. Igor Paixao will be replaced by Mason Greenwood (Marseille).
58' That's the end of the game for Timothy Weah, who is replaced by Emerson (Marseille).
55' Igor Paixao (Marseille) creates some space for himself and unleashes a strike from long range, but his effort sails just wide of the right post.
53' Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
49' Referee Jeremie Pignard points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) goes wild in celebration.
49' Attention! Referee Jeremie Pignard straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
48' A goal, which was scored by Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg), was disallowed due to offside.
46' Half-time substitution. Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) will not participate anymore and Samuel Amo-Ameyaw is coming on.
46' Half-time substitution. Liam Rosenior decided to make a change. Kendry Paez is replaced by Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
43' Facundo Medina (Marseille) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

41' Igor Paixao (Marseille) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Mike Penders.
38' Matt O'Riley (Marseille) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
37' Matt O'Riley (Marseille) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
32' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
31' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Amine Gouiri (Marseille) heads on.
30' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Mike Penders.
27' Michael Murillo (Marseille) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
24' Nayef Aguerd (Marseille) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jeremie Pignard ignores the protests.
21' Marseille enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
20' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
19' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Strasbourg players look gutted.
18' Wait! Referee Jeremie Pignard immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
17' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
16' Kendry Paez (Strasbourg) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
15' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
11' Facundo Medina (Marseille) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
8' A fine pass finds Amine Gouiri (Marseille) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Mike Penders reacts superbly to deny him.

7' Timothy Weah (Marseille) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
6' Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
4' Strasbourg players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
1' The first half has just begun.
Marseille will kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
